name: The Forge
text: A soot-black anvil and a patient smith. Strip an item's infusion, for gold.

name: A Fallen Cache
text: Someone's gear, left where they fell. An item, free to take.

name: A Rift Seep
text: Essence beads on the rocks like dew. An essence, free to take.

name: Scattered Coin
text: Coins glint in the ash. Gold, free to take.

name: A Sealed Vault
text: Spend a key on a sealed chest: a better item or a relic.

name: The Old Drill Yard
text: Straw targets and a stern old sergeant. Switch a hero to another specialization.

name: A Rift Skirmish
text: Rift-spawn block the road. Fight them for a second helping of spoils; losing costs nothing.
